dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent and sharp pale edges create distinct linear boundaries against the darker grey-brown centers of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct transition boundary is visible where the uniform pale buff-grey coloration of the crown and nape meets the dark-centered, scalloped pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive imbricated feather pattern across the dorsal surface, characterized by dark almond-shaped centers and broad, pale margins.
